name: KRBL Ltd
title: KRBL Ltd - 530813 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 domestic revenue record INR1,230 cr (+22%) but exports fell 33% to INR279 cr on Middle East disruption; paddy and rice inventory fell to 657k tonnes and no export run-rate or guidance was given.

triggers.label: Q4 exports down 33% to INR279 cr
triggers.quote: Our export revenues for Q4 FY2026 stood at INR279 crores compared to INR450 crores in Q4 FY2025.

triggers.label: Domestic realisation +2-3% expected Q1
triggers.quote: I think another 2% to 3% improvement in average realization will be seen in quarter one in the domestic front.

triggers.label: Rice inventory 476k → 427k tons
triggers.quote: rice inventory stood at 230,000 tons and 427,000 tons, respectively, compared to 217,000 tons and 476,000 tons

triggers.label: Domestic volume growth ~10% target
triggers.quote: we are working towards the 10% volume growth year-over-year.

guidance.quote: we are working towards the 10% volume growth year-over-year.
another 2% to 3% improvement in average realization will be seen in quarter one in the domestic front.
A dividend of 450% of face value translating into INR103 crores has been approved by the Board

red_flags.label: ED matter sub judice; management declined to respond
red_flags.quote: as the ED matter is sub judice , we will not be in a position to respond to queries on this matter.

red_flags.label: Export channel inventory not quantified; April export run-rate withheld
red_flags.quote: We don’t have. April number, we don’t.

red_flags.label: Real estate capital allocation undecided
red_flags.quote: we are not very clear whether we should invest in real estate or not

evasions.quote: we don't have Q4 market share levels.

evasions.topic: April export run-rate and Q1 export trend
evasions.quote: We'll not be able to share month-wise numbers.
difficult to comment on channel inventory
It is too premature to comment anything on the price.
